gate.rule: median over exactly three distinct seeds of NM-LSPG max relative error <= 1.5 % (diverged seed = inf) AND a converged, finite LS-LSPG control >= 10 %; HR gate: median NM-LSPG-HR (55 basis / 58 samples) <= 2 %
gate.note: published 34-38 % is LS-LSPG-HR; this control is LS-LSPG without HR (their Fig. 13 shows LS-LSPG >> NM-LSPG at n_s=5)

selection.rule: smallest worst evolved NM-LSPG error on the 16-case tuning subset (train cases 112-127)

timing_contract: supplied dense initial field resident on GPU -> six dense (L+1)^2 fields resident on GPU, block_until_ready; 0.25 s GPU burn-in before every invocation; fresh random subject order per (repetition, case)
